intervention: One positive scalar T fitted by in-scope validation NLL; classifier weights, data and class predictions fixed.
primary_endpoint_unchanged: MSP OOS F1 with validation max-OOS-F1 thresholds; negative result retained.
calibration_endpoints: In-scope test NLL, ECE (15 equal-width bins), multiclass Brier (sum over classes).
threshold_control: Same selection algorithm and validation data in both arms; numeric thresholds differ because scores change units.

conditional_bootstrap.unit: same test row in both arms
conditional_bootstrap.scope: Each fixed seed separately; excludes training and validation-selection uncertainty.

historical_limitations: BERT checkpoint selection and temperature fitting both use in-scope validation: validation-fit calibration is not independent validation.
Temperature fitting and threshold selection reuse validation rows; test labels do not enter either optimization.
This audit follows existing test exposure and is not a new preregistration or unseen confirmation set.
Only three training seeds; no population-level significance claim from n=3.
One-dimensional calibration is not an OOS training objective and need not preserve across-example uncertainty rankings.
